name: branding-business-card-circuit-dark-green
title: Dark green circuit-line tech business card
whatItIs: A two-sided business card mockup on a wood surface, using thin green circuit-trace lines over a black background with white/green typography for name and contact details.
whatItMeans: Circuit-line traces read instantly as 'tech company' without needing a literal chip or gadget icon, letting the typography stay the clear focal point.
techniques: draw thin branching circuit-trace lines as a background texture standing in for a tech logo mark
limit the palette to black, one accent green and white for high contrast at small card size
carry the same corner graphic motif from front to back for a matched two-sided card

vocabulary.definition: a thin line motif resembling the conductive paths on a printed circuit board
